The MuZeum

Download Now

"So many species have gone extinct… But now here we are, in the last days of humanity…" 

 "Do you think we’ll make it?" 


I was at a dead-end, desperately battling a horde of zombies coming at us with my friend Sophie.

But a man opened the door of the building next to us and saved us at the crucial moment. 

Turns out he's the curator of the Natural History Museum we're in currently... He even generously offered us to stay the night until it’s safe to leave again in the morning. 

I feel so moved, seeing there are still some good people in this wrecked world...

...That’s good and all, but what am I doing, going on a guided tour with him in the dead of the night?

And there’s even pop quizzes?! Man, school being out was the one good thing about the apocalypse… How is he so motivated to continue sharing his knowledge, when we’re at the end of the world? 

"Proceed with caution", he says. "There might still be creatures roaming around the halls…"

Didn’t you say this place was safe?!


Content warnings:

Zombies, cannibalism, gore

Made for Spooktober 2025!



❖ 10k words — a complete story

❖ 9 endings, multiple ways to get to each one (3 happy, 1 neutral, 5 bad, with ending 5 having 3 variants)

❖  Your survival depends on choices and personality. Romance or friendship are optional, survival is obligatory! Will you be the kind and trustful one? The paranoid one? The selfish one?  Unless you're just lost, trying to find a meaning in this world... 

❖ Original Art, CGs and Music

❖ Gender-neutral MC

❖ One LI

❖ VAs for all main characters

Update 07/10/2025: v1.2.0, with VA (partial for curator, full for receptionist), music patch and new art

Update 10/10/2025: v1.2.1, Sophie's VA added in! 

Update 01/07/26: New updated version is out (v1.4.0), curator's VA added in + added script, new SFX and art. If you had downloaded the game before, please download again!

If you liked it, please consider RATING this game to help more people discover it!

A word from the curator

Thank you for your interest in me and my preservation work. Perhaps you’d like to contribute to it? I am currently preparing a new exhibition, you see… And there are some vacant shelves which need to be filled with new specimens…

Thank you so much, glad that you liked it! Everyone on the team did so well on it. It was fun to make the different routes so that you can go full survival mode, stay oblivious to it all or embrace the crazy XD 

You can find the walkthrough for all endings here. 

Ending 7 choices:

TLDR: Be nice and selfless with Sophie but selfish with Curator, buff her combat abilities and debuff his

Let Sophie go to the toilets first + give your weapon to her when she asks for it (so that she's able to defend herself and survive). Then later when zombie appears, choose  "Flee" + ("Bolt for the next room" or "Guarantee your survival") => that way, Curator is forced to waste a lot of ammunition to save himself. In the last room, disagree ("Humanity...") and choose "Fight".
